definitions.explanation: The second trial of a case after a first-instance judgment has been appealed, usually held at a high court.

examples.japanese: {控訴審|こうそしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{控訴審|こうそしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覆|くつがえ}った→覆る：20833_kutsugaeru⟧。
examples.english: The verdict was overturned on appeal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{控訴審|こうそしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧し{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The defendant continues to plead not guilty in the appeal trial.

notes:
⟦{控訴|こうそ}→控訴：05966_kouso⟧ (appeal against a first-instance judgment) + {審|しん} (hearing). In Japan's three-tier courts, the {控訴審|こうそしん} is the second trial, usually at a high court ({高等裁判所|こうとうさいばんしょ}); a further appeal to the Supreme Court is ⟦{上告|じょうこく}→上告：14864_joukoku⟧. A constant in court news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {控訴審|こうそしん}⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧: the appeal court's ruling
- {控訴審|こうそしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{初公判|はつこうはん}: the first hearing of an appeal trial
- {控訴審|こうそしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{争|あらそ}う→争う：01866_arasou⟧: to contest a case on appeal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一審|いっしん}: first-instance trial
- {上告審|じょうこくしん}: appeal hearing at the Supreme Court
